meta.title: {app}: the POS built for phone repair shops
meta.description: Repair tickets in 30 seconds, WhatsApp updates, accessories checkout with barcode scanning, USD and LBP side by side. In English and Arabic. 14-day free trial.

marketing.demoMessage: Hi! I'd like a free demo of {app} for my phone repair shop.

hero.title: The POS built for phone repair shops
hero.subtitle: Log a repair in 30 seconds, tell the customer on WhatsApp when it's ready, and sell accessories in dollars or lira. One simple screen for the whole counter.

day.title: Built around how your shop actually runs
day.subtitle: From opening the drawer in the morning to the closing report at night, every step is a tap away.

tickets.title: Repair tickets in 30 seconds
tickets.body: Search the customer by phone, pick the device, describe the problem and print. Passcode or pattern lock, accessories left and parts used are all on the ticket.
tickets.b1: Clear statuses: received, diagnosing, waiting for part, repairing, ready
tickets.b2: Kanban board to move phones along the bench
tickets.b3: Parts come out of stock automatically

whatsapp.title: Tell the customer on WhatsApp in one tap
whatsapp.body: When a phone is ready, tap WhatsApp and the message opens already written, in English or Arabic. Works with your normal WhatsApp: no business account, no setup.
whatsapp.b1: Templates for received, ready and reminders

currency.title: Dollars and lira, side by side
currency.body: Set today's rate once in the morning. Every price, total and receipt shows USD and LBP, and the customer can pay in either currency and get change in either.
currency.b1: Mixed payments: part dollars, part lira
currency.b2: Change calculated in the currency you choose
currency.b3: LBP rounding to the nearest 1,000 or 5,000

pos.title: Fast checkout for accessories
pos.body: Scan a barcode or type a name: chargers, cases and cables go straight into the cart.

inventory.title: Inventory that warns you first
inventory.body: Low-stock alerts before you run out, and barcode labels printed from the shop.

cash.title: Cash drawer and daily reports
cash.body: Open and close the drawer in both currencies, see what's missing, and check sales and repairs by day.

track.title: Customer status page via QR
track.body: A QR code on the receipt lets customers check their repair status without calling you.

language.title: English and Arabic, fully
language.body: Each person picks their language. Arabic is right-to-left everywhere, receipts included.

staff.title: Staff roles
staff.body: Owner, manager, technician and cashier, each with only the access they need.

local.title: Works the way Lebanese shops work

payments.title: Whish, OMT, cash or card
payments.body: Record how each customer paid. Nothing to connect, nothing to approve.

currency.title: Dual currency
currency.body: USD and LBP on every screen and receipt, with your own daily rate.

printing.title: 80mm thermal printing
printing.body: Receipts and ticket slips on the printer you already have, or A4.

tablet.title: Made for a tablet at the counter
tablet.body: Big buttons and a clean layout that also works on a laptop or phone.

pricing.title: Simple monthly pricing
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes every feature. Start with a 14-day free trial; pay monthly or yearly.
pricing.staff: Up to {count, plural, one {# staff account} other {# staff accounts}}
pricing.contactBody: Tell us about your shop and we'll set you up with a free trial and a plan that fits.

faq.title: Questions shop owners ask
faq.a1: No. Messages open in your normal WhatsApp (or WhatsApp Business if you have it) with the text already written. You just press send.
faq.q2: Is my data safe and separate from other shops?
faq.a2: Yes. Each shop is fully isolated with its own address and its own data. Staff only see what their role allows.
faq.a3: It needs an internet connection. Any connection works, including a phone hotspot when the line is down.
faq.a4: Yes. 80mm thermal receipts and ticket slips, and A4 when you need a full page. Receipts show USD and LBP and a QR code for the status page.
faq.q5: How do I pay for the subscription?
faq.a5: Manually, by cash, Whish, OMT or bank transfer, monthly or yearly. No card needed.

cta.title: See it with your own tickets
cta.body: A 15-minute demo on WhatsApp. We'll set up your shop and you can start the free trial the same day.

footer.tagline: The POS built for phone repair shops.
